keyable.input: one normalized key TypeId and finite visible conformance environment
ordered_steps: normalize transparent aliases and require one stable semantic value identity
select exactly one direct-global strong Eq<Self> witness and one direct-global Hash<Self> witness owned by the same Keyable family
require Eq to be reflexive symmetric and transitive over all admitted values
require hash congruence: Eq(a,b) implies Hash(a) equals Hash(b) for the same HashPolicyId
require equality and hashing to borrow without consume, mutation, allocation, suspension, cancellation, authority, Error or Effect residue
seal KeyableWitnessId, EqWitnessId, HashWitnessId and HashPolicyId before Map or Set planning
admitted_domains: closed Prelude scalar and immutable value rows with registered strong Eq and Hash
Rational through its sealed canonical-normal-form row
user nominal values only through one coherent direct-global registered family
rejected_domains: Float32, Float64 and Float alias because NaN defeats strong Eq
mutable, identity-address, lifecycle-bearing or authority-bearing values
partial equality, provider lookup, runtime reflection or per-instance hash policy
keyable.failure_atomicity: failure emits no witness, MapLiteralPlan, Set plan, allocation or partial collection

iteration.input: one evaluated for-source TypeId, loop Pattern policy and static responsibility context
route_order: DIRECT_ITERATOR when the source has one exact Iterator conformance
SEQUENCE_ACQUIRE otherwise when the source has one exact Sequence conformance whose iterator result has one exact Iterator conformance
ordered_steps: evaluate the source exactly once into a loop-owned temporary
select one route without provider, source-order or runtime fallback
seal Sequence ConformanceId if used, Iterator ConformanceId, IteratorWitnessId and exact associated Item TypeId
acquire the iterator exactly once and account for its declared ErrorSet, EffectRow and cleanup before loop entry
call next in source order; none exits and some(item) enters one PatternAttempt
bare for requires an irrefutable Pattern; for let may reject a candidate or its pure Bool guard and continue
on continue, break, return, Error, Defect or cancellation clean the current item, iterator and source exactly once in reverse ownership order

current_profile.async_surface: for#await belongs to the separate AsyncSequence profile

pattern_assignment.normalization: both surfaces become one PatternAssignmentPlan with an ordered structural assignee and one RHS expression
admitted_shapes: List when irrefutability is statically proven for the exact RHS type
pattern_assignment.leaf_policy: every non-wildcard leaf and rest capture resolves to an existing direct mutable local LocalPlaceId; no declaration occurs
ordered_steps: resolve every target before evaluating the RHS
prove the complete assignee irrefutable for the exact RHS type and require exact field, element and rest types
reject duplicate or overlapping LocalPlaceIds and every member, index, property, shared, actor, FFI or potentially aliasing target
evaluate the RHS exactly once and stage all projected replacement values left to right without target writes
reserve every old-owner replacement and prove the commit path infallible and callback-free
cross one PatternAssignmentCommitId barrier and publish all writes logically together
clean displaced old owners in reverse target order after commit
pattern_assignment.failure_atomicity: before the barrier target_write_count is zero and every old value remains live; failure reverse-cleans only new temporaries
